editorial.title_zh: 德国DAkkS认可TÜV南德CBAM核查资质，涵盖粗钢和钢铁制品
editorial.title_en: DAkkS accredits TÜV SÜD for CBAM verification covering crude steel and iron and steel products
editorial.summary_zh: TÜV南德11月26日公告称，德国认可机构DAkkS已于11月18日认可TÜV SÜD Industrie Service GmbH为欧盟CBAM核查机构。DAkkS证书附件D-VS-14153-01-01有效期为2026年11月18日至2028年12月10日。第5页的CBAM范围包括V组（烧结矿、生铁、直接还原铁及粗钢）、VI组所列铁合金和VIII组（钢铁制品等），核查现场所在国按Flex B管理。公开附件未列明该机构当前可在中国开展现场核查的具体范围。欧盟2026年度首份CBAM申报及交证截止日均为2027年9月30日。
editorial.summary_en: On 26 November TÜV SÜD announced that DAkkS had accredited TÜV SÜD Industrie Service GmbH on 18 November. Annex D-VS-14153-01-01 runs to 10 December 2028 and lists CBAM groups V (including crude steel), VI (specified ferroalloys) and VIII (including iron and steel products). Site-visit countries are managed under Flex B and the published annex does not specify current on-site coverage in China. The first CBAM declaration and surrender for 2026 are due 30 September 2027.
editorial.impact_zh: 对于输欧板坯、热卷、冷轧及镀层板等适用CBAM的产品，若进口商拟用实际排放申报，可把该德国法人列入询价名单。委托前请其书面确认中国所在厂区、对应产品组和前体覆盖、现场档期及出具报告的主体，并与进口商确认报告交付节点。现有成本报价仍按合同所用的排放情景测算。
editorial.impact_en: For EU-bound slabs and flat steel using actual emissions, request a quote from the accredited German entity and obtain written confirmation of Chinese plant coverage, activity groups, precursors, site-visit capacity and the entity issuing the report. Agree report delivery timing with the EU importer.
editorial.coverage: 核对DAkkS证书附件第5页、TÜV南德11月26日德文公告和现行CBAM条例第6、8、22条。企业公告链接 https://www.tuvsud.com/de-de/presse-und-medien/2026/november/cbam-akkreditierung 。中国现场覆盖须由核查机构按现行详细范围书面确认。

editorial.title_zh: 美国对印度拟设最高25%产能过剩301关税，现已适用232的钢铁产品拟排除
editorial.title_en: US proposes up to 25% Section 301 tariff for India, with exclusions for steel already under Section 232
editorial.summary_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室11月25日公布对印度产能过剩的301调查认定及拟议行动。一般拟议税率最高25%，扣除现有301关税，按豁免范围执行。公告第V节明确拟排除已适用232关税的钢、铝、铜制品及相关钢铝衍生品，另有附件A所列豁免。若美印达成回应本案认定的互惠贸易协议，USTR另考虑17%的情景。听证申请和书面意见均于2027年1月5日截止，听证拟于1月25日召开。公告尚未确定新税适用日。
editorial.summary_en: USTR's 25 November India determination proposes duties up to 25%, net of existing Section 301 tariffs. Section V proposes to exclude steel, aluminium and copper articles and specified derivatives already subject to Section 232, alongside Annex A exclusions. USTR is also considering 17% if a qualifying reciprocal trade agreement is reached. Comments and hearing requests are due 5 January 2027, with a hearing scheduled for 25 January.
editorial.impact_zh: 与印度供应商比较输美热卷、冷轧、镀层板或钢制品报价时，先按具体HTSUS确认其是否实际适用232，再看附件A及已有双反税。现阶段维持原报价和清关口径。跨年合同可单列非232衍生品在不同税率情景下的成本。中国原产钢材继续按中国案及现行税则核对。
editorial.impact_en: For U.S. quotes against Indian hot-rolled, cold-rolled and coated steel or fabricated products, confirm Section 232 coverage by HTSUS line and check Annex A and existing trade remedies. Keep existing entry treatment and model tariff scenarios separately for derivatives outside Section 232.
editorial.coverage: 核对USTR公告正文第V至VIII节、附件A说明及11月25日发布页。该条补充已核验的14经济体主条中未展开的印度排除范围，未逐个商品判断最终适用。

editorial.title_zh: 荷兰统计局估算上半年进口CBAM成本1.213亿欧元，钢铁占9330万欧元
editorial.title_en: Statistics Netherlands estimates H1 CBAM costs at EUR 121.3 million, including EUR 93.3 million for iron and steel
editorial.summary_zh: 荷兰统计局CBS于11月26日公布初步估算：2026年上半年，研究涵盖的荷兰进口企业CBAM成本估计为1.213亿欧元，其中钢铁类别9330万欧元。中国原产货物在全部被估算CBAM类别中占29.2%，约3540万欧元。CBS将企业数据与欧盟海关数据结合，并采用荷兰排放管理局的CBAM计算工具。国别与品类是不同拆分口径，以上金额均按研究估算理解。
editorial.summary_en: Statistics Netherlands estimates provisional H1 2026 CBAM costs for the covered Dutch importers at EUR 121.3 million, of which iron and steel accounted for EUR 93.3 million. Chinese-origin goods accounted for about EUR 35.4 million across all CBAM categories. CBS combined business and customs data and used the Dutch Emissions Authority's calculator.
editorial.impact_zh: 荷兰进口商可用该估算了解行业成本敞口。板坯、热卷、冷轧及镀层板的合同分摊仍按对应税号、核查排放和合同证价口径单独测算，保留实际排放和适用默认值两种情景供客户比价。
editorial.impact_en: Use the estimate as market context. Base slab and flat steel contract calculations on the relevant codes, verified emissions and agreed certificate pricing, with a separate default-value scenario where applicable.
editorial.coverage: 核对CBS原始统计、临时数据表和成本方法说明。分组金额为估算，未取得覆盖各钢材税号的进口商实缴数据。

editorial.title_zh: 欧盟与瑞士公布2027年ETS跨登记册配额划转日历
editorial.title_en: EU and Switzerland publish 2027 ETS cross-registry allowance transfer calendar
editorial.summary_zh: 欧委会气候行动总司11月26日公布欧盟与瑞士2027年ETS配额划转安排，延续既有互联机制，通常在周一至周五执行。按发起方登记册规则，欧盟端处理前有26小时延时，瑞士端为24小时。例外包括2026年12月28日至2027年1月1日，以及2027年12月23日至31日，另有公告列明的节假日停办。
editorial.summary_en: DG CLIMA published the 2027 EU–Swiss ETS allowance transfer calendar on 26 November. Weekday transfers continue under the existing link subject to closure dates and initiation-side delays of 26 hours in the EU registry and 24 hours in the Swiss registry.
editorial.impact_zh: 需要通过欧瑞登记册跨境调拨排放配额的客户应在节假日前给碳资产团队预留处理时间。钢材出口仍按货物原产地和各市场现行CBAM规定核算报价和准备清关文件。
editorial.impact_en: Counterparties using cross-registry ETS transfers should allow extra time before holiday closures. Steel customs and CBAM treatment continues to follow product origin and applicable market rules.
editorial.coverage: 核对欧委会公告正文及2027年停办日历。官网发布日期为11月26日，队列的UTC日期为11月25日，保留原匹配日期。

editorial.title_zh: 欧英完成ETS互联谈判，目标2028年实施，欧盟CBAM仍待另行修法
editorial.title_en: EU and UK conclude ETS linking negotiations with a 2028 target; EU CBAM exemption requires a separate measure
editorial.summary_zh: 欧委会气候行动总司11月20日公告确认，双方完成ETS互联协议谈判，目标2028年1月1日起适用，仍取决于批准和生效程序。委员会税务与海关总司说明，欧盟拟另行修订CBAM条例附件III处理英国原产商品豁免。英国11月23日发布的本国CBAM草案拟在获御准后追溯适用于2027年1月1日起符合条件的欧盟、欧洲经济区和瑞士原产货物。
editorial.summary_en: DG CLIMA confirms talks concluded on 20 November with a 1 January 2028 target, subject to ratification and entry into force. An EU CBAM exemption for UK-origin goods needs a separate Annex III amendment. The UK's own draft would apply from 1 January 2027 after Royal Assent.
editorial.impact_zh: 分别跟踪欧盟与英国的生效文件。中国原产板坯、冷轧及涂镀钢材经英国或欧盟中转时，按原产地规则和进口市场的现行CBAM制度安排报价和申报。
editorial.impact_en: Track the EU and UK legal steps separately. Quote and declare Chinese-origin slabs and flat steel moving via either market under the importing market's origin and CBAM rules.
editorial.coverage: 复核DG CLIMA该来源版本及其税务与海关总司配套说明。与已核验的11月20日公告和11月25日编辑结论一致，未见新增生效文件。

editorial.title_zh: 欧盟钢铁新规首季运行定向咨询已关闭，待委员会公布评估
editorial.title_en: EU consultation on first-quarter operation of its steel regulation has closed
editorial.summary_zh: 欧委会咨询页面确认，针对条例(EU) 2026/1384首季运行情况的咨询于9月28日开放，10月11日23:59（中欧夏令时）截止。参与者原可按附录I产品类别分别回复。当前页面显示已关闭，截至核验时未公布反馈汇总、评估结果或配额、税率调整。
editorial.summary_en: The Commission confirms the first-quarter monitoring consultation for Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 opened on 28 September and closed on 11 October at 23:59 CEST. The page offers no response summary or quota or rate change.
editorial.impact_zh: 按正式配额安排和有效税率继续执行赴欧订单。进口商可按配额类别留存清关量、延误和超配额成本资料，用于后续评估。
editorial.impact_en: Use current quotas and duties on EU orders. Retain records of customs volumes, delays and out-of-quota costs by category for future monitoring.
editorial.coverage: 核对欧委会最新来源版本的状态、开放和截止时间及回复结束提示，和此前已核验的关闭结论一致。
